verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows ByteAsk as a terminal coding agent with its own toolchain integrations (compiler, sanitizers, gdb, test suite) and even a first-party 'ByteAsk-Embedded-MCP' repo, but that repo describes ByteAsk exposing tools *as* an MCP server for other agents, not ByteAsk *consuming* external MCP servers as a client. No documentation, CLI reference, or changelog entry describes a way for users to register/plug in third-party MCP servers so ByteAsk can call their tools.
